result:
I've fixed F-DG4-128 (finding open until a reviewer verifies it). The shipped worker now gives pg-boss a 60 s supervision interval instead of none. The worker reads it from a new setting, `WORKER_SUPERVISE_INTERVAL_SECONDS` (whole seconds, 1–600, checked at start-up). Every required check exited 0, and the changes are uncommitted for you to integrate.

**Before and after** (the reviewer's `measure-supervise.sh`, worker idle):

| | Before (HEAD `8e2375c`) | After the fix |
|---|---|---|
| `TimeoutNaNWarning` at start-up | yes, raised from pg-boss's `Boss.start` | none |
| Database transactions per second | 9,418 | 16 (the reviewer's 60 s control was also 16) |
| Worker CPU ticks in 20 s | 1,631 (about 0.8 of a core) | 37 |

**What changed:**
- **`createBoss`** always passes an interval: the caller's value, or 60 by default. It throws on anything that isn't a whole number from 1 to 600, so an empty value or NaN can no longer reach pg-boss.
- **`main.ts`** passes the configured value and includes it in the "mth-worker started" log line.
- **pg-boss option audit:** this is the only timer setting pg-boss 11.0.0 leaves without a default. Its other timers all have finite defaults. The handback has the table, one row per option.
- **The 60 s figure** comes from D-131 and the finding. The installed pg-boss package doesn't document it, and I couldn't check the online documentation offline.

**Outside my named files:** to make the interval configurable the way ADR-0011 requires, I also edited `packages/config/src/{index,load,load.test}.ts` and regenerated `.env.example` (CI checks it against the config list). The front-end task doesn't own any of these, and `apps/api` is unchanged. I didn't touch `deploy/compose/compose.yaml`, so Compose runs on the 60 s default; the handback describes the optional devops change.

**New test** (`apps/worker/test/integration/supervise-cadence.test.ts`, 9 tests, real PostgreSQL). It starts the real `src/main.ts` with the shipped defaults. It checks that pg-boss's supervision timer is exactly 60,000 ms, that every timer is a finite number and that no `TimeoutNaNWarning` appears. It also covers a configured value, invalid values (exit 78) and the original bare `createBoss(url)` call. On the original source all 9 fail, including `expected [ NaN ] to deeply equal [ 60000 ]`; both logs are kept. The tests that pass 1 s explicitly are unchanged.

**Checks:**

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG3` | 0 | run at the start and at the end |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 | |
| prettier check | 0 | the first run exited 123 because two of my files needed formatting; fixed and re-run |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | 0, 0 | 2,929 passed, plus 259 passed and 2 skipped in the no-codegen run; the +12 are my config tests and the 2 skips were already there |
| `pnpm test:integration` | 0 | 209 files, 1,984 tests, no failures, nothing re-run |

The restart tests and the A13 test (REQ-S16-005) all pass.

The reviewer's integration count of 209/1,985 included their own `zz-domain-r6.test.ts` (10 tests), which isn't in the repository. So the repository suite went from 208/1,975 to 209/1,984, and the 9 new tests are mine.

**Other notes:**
- **Routed operations:** none, so my pending list is unchanged. There are no migrations and no OpenAPI or schema changes.
- **Measurement scripts:** I ran copies of the reviewer's scripts on my ports, passing the worker's process ID in directly instead of finding it with `pgrep -f`. The sampling is unchanged.
- **Log trailers:** the `exit=0` line at the end of the typecheck, lint, prettier and OpenAPI logs was added afterwards from the exit codes the shell reported.
- **Not measured:** whether the old 1 ms loop contributed to the load timeouts in earlier stack and e2e runs, as the reviewer suggested.
- **Next step:** after merging, run `pnpm -r build` so the stack and e2e scripts, which run the built files, pick up the fix.
- **Time:** 16:55–17:41 UTC.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG4/`:
- `T-DG4-BE-R6-backend-workflow-engineer.md`
- `T-DG4-BE-R6-evidence/`
